p15/esc1006:1.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1006:1.text: I have mixed feelings sad and angry at the same time.

p15/esc1006:10.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1006:10.text: I just had good conversations with my mom to express my thoughts. Did you have a frank chat with your mom to express your concerns?

p15/esc1006:11.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1006:11.text: I try to but it never ends well if I don't agree with her suggestions.

p15/esc1006:12.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1006:12.text: Take a deep breath and it can make you feel better.

p15/esc1006:13.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1006:13.text: What are her concerns about your friends?

p15/esc1006:14.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1006:14.text: OK! I have taken a deep breath.

p15/esc1006:15.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1006:15.text: ok, that's good. tell me more about your mom's concerns of your friends.

p15/esc1006:16.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1006:16.text: She feels that they have some bad influence on me because of their family background. I don't do anything bad with them.

p15/esc1006:17.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1006:17.text: Some of my friends are so good they even inspire me to be better everyday.

p15/esc1006:18.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1006:18.text: My mom told me similar concerns before. It is understandable.

p15/esc1006:19.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1006:19.text: All I need is to find a way to show her that I can make some good decisions as well and that she can trust me to make good friends. I have never gotten into trouble before with my friends

p15/esc1006:2.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1006:2.text: It seems that you are feeling blue and upset by others, right?

p15/esc1006:20.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1006:20.text: My suggestion is that tell her these facts and she can make a better decision. I think she assumed your friends are bad influencers just based on their family background.

p15/esc1006:21.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1006:21.text: Do I need to buy her a gift or something to let her know I care so as to start the conversation?

p15/esc1006:22.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1006:22.text: Yes, a good idea, it pleases her.

p15/esc1006:25.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1006:25.text: You are welcome. Hope it will go well.

p15/esc1006:3.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1006:3.text: Yes. Am sad because I love my mom so much and I never like to get into arguments with her.

p15/esc1006:4.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1006:4.text: From the short conversation, I can feel how sad you are.

p15/esc1006:5.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1006:5.text: Yes. My mom never approves of most of the things I do.

p15/esc1006:6.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1006:6.text: What kind of arguments did you have with your mom?

p15/esc1006:7.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1006:7.text: Like the kind of friends I should have. I believe I have freedom to choose my friends not her.

p15/esc1006:8.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1006:8.text: I had similar situation like yours. My mom did not want me to make friends with some people.

p15/esc1006:9.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1006:9.text: Really? How did you deal with that because for me it makes me angry.

p15/esc1138:1.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1138:1.text: Hi, how are you feeling today?

p15/esc1138:10.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1138:10.text: I have. It's been a long stressful month of discussion. The problem is I don't share their beliefs, and I haven't been really "saving myself". I'm been living away from them for collage quite a while and I've been basically doing stuff that if they found out they would be very upset about.

p15/esc1138:11.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1138:11.text: But I didn't think it bothers them because they never shared any of this.

p15/esc1138:12.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1138:12.text: And they said if I go on this trip I'm disrespecting them and the entire family.

p15/esc1138:13.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1138:13.text: But his parents are totally cool and don't seem to mind.

p15/esc1138:14.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1138:14.text: I get how difficult and upsetting this situation is to you, i have been in a similar situation, however, in my case i took charge of my life, though they are my parents i did what i felt is good for me

p15/esc1138:15.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1138:15.text: Before i continue, do you mind me asking how old you are?

p15/esc1138:17.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1138:17.text: And I see what you're saying.

p15/esc1138:18.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1138:18.text: It's really hard breaking free because they always monitored me my entire life.

p15/esc1138:19.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1138:19.text: I never had a voice for myself. They basically bullied and forced me to do what they wanted.

p15/esc1138:2.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1138:2.text: I'm feeling a bit confused and anxious.

p15/esc1138:20.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1138:20.text: BTW if you didn't guess I'm their favorite child.

p15/esc1138:21.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1138:21.text: Okay, you are old enough to be away from your parents, i am going to suggest you sitting with them down and having a heart to heart discussion with them

p15/esc1138:22.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1138:22.text: Let them know the consequences of them forcing you, your feelings towards it and how unhappy you are with them restricting you

p15/esc1138:23.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1138:23.text: Should I tell them everything I did that goes against what they believe?

p15/esc1138:24.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1138:24.text: So they know that I don't share their beliefs?

p15/esc1138:25.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1138:25.text: No, i think that should be personal to you, i would not suggest you hurting or making them see you as a disappointment

p15/esc1138:26.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1138:26.text: I am sure you will be fine after discussing with them, they will come around

p15/esc1138:27.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1138:27.text: I guess worst case I won't talk to them for a while : )

p15/esc1138:29.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1138:29.text: They might be sad and upset now but they will get over it definitely

p15/esc1138:3.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1138:3.text: okay, that is valid, do you have an idea what is causing the confusion?

p15/esc1138:4.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1138:4.text: So I've been dating and my parents are aware. But recently after I said I want to go on a trip with my boyfriend, my parents have all sorts of opinions about it. And all their traditional beliefs that I did not know existed are now on the surface and they are kinda forcing me to follow it.

p15/esc1138:5.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1138:5.text: For say they think "bad types of woman" go on trips with their boyfriends and I need to save myself.

p15/esc1138:6.speaker: seeker
p15/esc1138:6.text: They have been guilt tripping me and I feel very confused.

p15/esc1138:7.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1138:7.text: Your feelings are valid and it is okay to feel confused in this situation considering you love your boyfriend and parents

p15/esc1138:8.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1138:8.text: Have you tried discussing with your boyfriend to talk to your parents as a means of reassuring them?

p15/esc1138:9.speaker: supporter
p15/esc1138:9.text: Or getting someone neutral that your parents trust to talk to them?

p15/esc119:0.speaker: supporter
p15/esc119:0.text: Hi there, how is this season treating you?

p15/esc119:1.speaker: seeker
p15/esc119:1.text: It's alright. Definitely not as cold as last year which is something to be slightly thankful for.

p15/esc119:10.speaker: seeker
p15/esc119:10.text: Sometimes I think about that. At the same time, I feel like it's unfair to compare myself to others.

p15/esc119:11.speaker: supporter
p15/esc119:11.text: This sounds like it might be a self esteem issue and not about your grades. I have felt this sort of thing myself and I do know how awful it is to be so hard on yourself.

p15/esc119:12.speaker: seeker
p15/esc119:12.text: So what do I do about it? I don't want to keep feeling like this

p15/esc119:13.speaker: supporter
p15/esc119:13.text: Have you thought about seeing a therapist? Does your school have any free therapy programmes you could use?

p15/esc119:14.speaker: seeker
p15/esc119:14.text: I don't think my school has free therapy programs. I have thought about seeing a therapist but I've heard therapy is very expensive.With student loans, I didn't really put much more research into therapy past hearing about the costs.

p15/esc119:15.speaker: supporter
p15/esc119:15.text: A far as I am aware there are charitable organisations which can arrange a few free therapy session for you. Perhaps you could talk to your doctor about it?

p15/esc119:16.speaker: supporter
p15/esc119:16.text: I have had free therapy sessions before and I found them very helpful

p15/esc119:17.speaker: seeker
p15/esc119:17.text: I think free therapy sessions would be a good place to start

p15/esc119:18.speaker: supporter
p15/esc119:18.text: It would help you work on your self confidence and you might find that you are not doing as badly in school as you think you are.

p15/esc119:19.speaker: seeker
p15/esc119:19.text: Yeah, there are definitely a lot of other things i'm insecure about

p15/esc119:2.speaker: supporter
p15/esc119:2.text: Well let's be grateful for small mercies :). How are you feeling in yourself though? Is there anything you'd like to talk about?

p15/esc119:20.speaker: supporter
p15/esc119:20.text: Then I think it is probably just a general self esteem issue and nothing academic!

p15/esc119:21.speaker: supporter
p15/esc119:21.text: Anyway it's been really nice to talk to you and I hope that everything goes your way

p15/esc119:22.speaker: seeker
p15/esc119:22.text: I think talking about this has helped. I'll do a little more digging. Thank you!

p15/esc119:23.speaker: supporter
p15/esc119:23.text: You're most welcome, have a lovely Holiday season.

p15/esc119:4.speaker: supporter
p15/esc119:4.text: Ah I am sorry to hear that. Please try not to worry too much as it's a common worry to have. Do you want to tell me the details?

p15/esc119:5.speaker: seeker
p15/esc119:5.text: Sure. One of my classes is extremely difficult and the professor has not been responsive at all. The TA is kind enough to make time to help me with homework, but my grades are still not great. It makes me feel really dumb and undeserving to be in that class

p15/esc119:6.speaker: supporter
p15/esc119:6.text: So you are feeling as though you are in the wrong place? Do you feel as though you might fail your class completely?

p15/esc119:7.speaker: seeker
p15/esc119:7.text: I want to be in the program, it's just that I feel like everyone is so much smarter than me and my performance in that class makes me question my admission into the programs sometimes. When I feel like this after submitting homework, I end up crying because I just want to do well. I enjoy this field, just not this  class in particular.

p15/esc119:8.speaker: seeker
p15/esc119:8.text: I'm afraid of failing, but I'm not sure if that should be a concern either. Over the past 3 years, no one has gotten a grade lower than a B.

p15/esc119:9.speaker: supporter
p15/esc119:9.text: But do you really think that you would have been admitted to the class if you were not up to the standard? Do you think that maybe most of your classmates are secretly feeling the same?

p15/p15_conv_10:0.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_10:0.text: Hi Kelly! How have you been doing?

p15/p15_conv_10:1.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_10:1.text: Hey! It's been a mixed bag lately, to be honest.

p15/p15_conv_10:10.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_10:10.text: That sounds like just the boost you needed. How are you feeling now?

p15/p15_conv_10:11.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_10:11.text: I feel lighter, like a weight's been lifted off my shoulders. It's nice to be reminded that I'm not alone.

p15/p15_conv_10:12.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_10:12.text: It's so valuable having someone to remind us of our strengths. Did you get a chance to talk more about what's been on your mind?

p15/p15_conv_10:13.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_10:13.text: Yeah, we chatted for a while. It helped me see things from a different perspective, especially regarding the thesis.

p15/p15_conv_10:2.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_10:2.text: I get that. Want to talk about what's been happening?

p15/p15_conv_10:3.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_10:3.text: Sure. You remember how I was stressed about my thesis? Well, my advisor's feedback was tough, but I actually got some unexpected support.

p15/p15_conv_10:4.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_10:4.text: Oh, that's interesting. Where did the support come from?

p15/p15_conv_10:5.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_10:5.text: It's from an old college friend I hadn't spoken to in a while. It was surprising but nice.

p15/p15_conv_10:6.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_10:6.text: That sounds wonderful. How did they reach out to you?

p15/p15_conv_10:7.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_10:7.text: They just sent me a message out of the blue, asking how I was doing. It was so random but perfectly timed.

p15/p15_conv_10:8.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_10:8.text: It's amazing how reconnecting with the right people can make such a difference. What did they say that really stuck with you?

p15/p15_conv_10:9.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_10:9.text: They reminded me of how much work I've already done and how capable I am. It was like they saw through my facade and just knew the right things to say.

p15/p15_conv_1:0.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_1:0.text: Hey Kelly, how are you doing today?

p15/p15_conv_1:1.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_1:1.text: Hey, to be honest, I'm struggling a bit.

p15/p15_conv_1:10.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_1:10.text: It's understandable to feel stuck. Sometimes taking a step back can help. Have you tried taking a break from it all?

p15/p15_conv_1:11.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_1:11.text: I've tried, but it's hard not to think about it. It feels like I'm letting myself down.

p15/p15_conv_1:12.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_1:12.text: You're not letting yourself down. You're doing your best under challenging circumstances. Remember when your friend mentioned overcoming similar doubts in his studies?

p15/p15_conv_1:13.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_1:13.text: Oh yeah, he struggled with something similar and he got through it. It took him a bit of time though.

p15/p15_conv_1:14.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_1:14.text: Exactly. Maybe his story can be a reminder that it's possible to bounce back. Have you reached out to your friends recently?

p15/p15_conv_1:15.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_1:15.text: Not recently. Maybe I should. Talking to someone who understands might help.

p15/p15_conv_1:16.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_1:16.text: That sounds like a great idea. And remember, I'm always here for you too. You have support.

p15/p15_conv_1:17.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_1:17.text: Thanks, I really appreciate that. It does help to know I'm not alone in this.

p15/p15_conv_1:18.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_1:18.text: You definitely aren't alone. How about focusing on one small step you can take today?

p15/p15_conv_1:19.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_1:19.text: Maybe I can start by reviewing the feedback more calmly, with a fresh perspective.

p15/p15_conv_1:2.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_1:2.text: I'm here to listen. Do you want to share what's been challenging for you?

p15/p15_conv_1:20.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_1:20.text: That sounds like a constructive plan. Taking it step by step and being kind to yourself on the journey can make a big difference.

p15/p15_conv_1:21.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_1:21.text: I’ll try to keep that in mind. Thank you for listening and helping me process things.

p15/p15_conv_1:22.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_1:22.text: Anytime, Kelly. You’ve got this, even if it doesn’t feel like it right now. Keep reaching out, okay?

p15/p15_conv_1:3.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_1:3.text: It's my thesis. I had a setback recently, and it's just really bringing me down.

p15/p15_conv_1:4.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_1:4.text: I can imagine that must be tough. What happened with your thesis?

p15/p15_conv_1:5.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_1:5.text: I got some feedback that I wasn't expecting. It made me realize there's a lot more work to do than I thought.

p15/p15_conv_1:6.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_1:6.text: That sounds overwhelming. It can be really hard to digest unexpected feedback.

p15/p15_conv_1:7.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_1:7.text: Exactly. I was feeling quite confident before, and now I just feel lost.

p15/p15_conv_1:8.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_1:8.text: It's okay to feel that way. Remember, feedback is part of the process. How are you managing these feelings?

p15/p15_conv_1:9.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_1:9.text: Not too well, honestly. I've been pretty demotivated and haven't been able to get much done.

p15/p15_conv_2:0.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_2:0.text: Hey, I really need to talk to someone.

p15/p15_conv_2:1.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_2:1.text: Hi Kelly! Of course, I'm here for you. What's on your mind?

p15/p15_conv_2:10.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_2:10.text: I want to approach them again and explain. But I'm worried they'll just see it as me being difficult or emotional.

p15/p15_conv_2:11.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_2:11.text: It's brave of you to want to reach out again. Maybe approaching them calmly and expressing how the situation made you feel could help clear the air.

p15/p15_conv_2:12.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_2:12.text: Yeah, I think I'll try that. I guess I'm also feeling extra sensitive lately because of that difficult class I'm taking.

p15/p15_conv_2:13.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_2:13.text: Having a tough class on top of this situation is a lot. It's no wonder you're feeling sensitive. How is that going for you?

p15/p15_conv_2:14.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_2:14.text: It's intense. I'm constantly worried I'm falling behind, and it's really impacting my self-esteem.

p15/p15_conv_2:15.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_2:15.text: That's tough. Balancing a challenging class with group dynamics can be overwhelming. Remember, it's okay to feel this way.

p15/p15_conv_2:16.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_2:16.text: Thank you. I've been considering therapy to help with these feelings and to improve my self-esteem.

p15/p15_conv_2:17.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_2:17.text: That sounds like a positive step. Taking care of your mental health is important, especially during stressful times.

p15/p15_conv_2:18.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_2:18.text: I'm glad you think so. I just hope it can help me manage everything better.

p15/p15_conv_2:19.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_2:19.text: I'm confident it will. You're taking the first steps towards understanding and improving your situation, and that's truly commendable.

p15/p15_conv_2:2.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_2:2.text: I got into an argument today with a classmate during our group project meeting. I'm feeling so overwhelmed.

p15/p15_conv_2:20.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_2:20.text: Thank you. It really helps to hear that and to talk to you.

p15/p15_conv_2:21.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_2:21.text: Anytime, Kelly. I'm always here to support you. You've got this, even when it feels challenging.

p15/p15_conv_2:22.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_2:22.text: I appreciate it more than you know. I guess I'll focus on clearing the air with my classmate and seeking therapy.

p15/p15_conv_2:23.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_2:23.text: That sounds like a great plan. Remember, you're stronger than you think, and you're not alone in this.

p15/p15_conv_2:3.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_2:3.text: I'm sorry to hear that. It sounds really stressful. What happened in the argument?

p15/p15_conv_2:4.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_2:4.text: We were discussing some decisions for the project, and they just dismissed my ideas completely. It made me feel invisible and undervalued.

p15/p15_conv_2:5.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_2:5.text: That must have been so frustrating. Everyone's contributions should be respected, especially in a group setting.

p15/p15_conv_2:6.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_2:6.text: Exactly. It's like, what am I even doing here if no one will listen.

p15/p15_conv_2:7.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_2:7.text: I can understand why that would make you question your place in the group. Did you manage to express how you felt to them?

p15/p15_conv_2:8.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_2:8.text: Sort of. I tried, but I think I let my emotions get the better of me and it just turned into more arguing. Now I'm worried I've damaged the group dynamic.

p15/p15_conv_2:9.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_2:9.text: Sometimes emotions can take over, especially when you're feeling undervalued. It's understandable. Have you thought about how you might address it with them?

p15/p15_conv_3:0.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_3:0.text: Hey Kelly, how are you feeling about your thesis presentation coming up?

p15/p15_conv_3:1.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_3:1.text: Hey! Honestly, I'm feeling pretty anxious about it.

p15/p15_conv_3:10.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_3:10.text: Great! And remember, you know your work better than anyone else. It’s normal to get caught off guard, but you've got this.

p15/p15_conv_3:11.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_3:11.text: Thanks, I appreciate that. I guess a part of me also wonders if people will even find my research interesting.

p15/p15_conv_3:12.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_3:12.text: Your research is your unique contribution. It's meaningful and valuable. Don't underestimate the impact it can have.

p15/p15_conv_3:13.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_3:13.text: I try to keep that in mind, but the doubt just keeps creeping in, you know?

p15/p15_conv_3:14.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_3:14.text: I understand. Doubt is tough. Maybe reflecting on why you started this research in the first place might help?

p15/p15_conv_3:15.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_3:15.text: I started it because I wanted to make a difference, and I was passionate about the topic. I guess I’ve lost sight of that a little.

p15/p15_conv_3:16.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_3:16.text: Reconnecting with that original passion can be a powerful motivator. It's still there, even if it feels lost right now.

p15/p15_conv_3:17.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_3:17.text: Yeah, it's reassuring to remember that. I don't want a repeat of that project argument from September either.

p15/p15_conv_3:18.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_3:18.text: I remember you mentioning that. It was a difficult situation, but you handled it well in the end. You grew from that experience.

p15/p15_conv_3:19.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_3:19.text: I did, didn't I? It's just hard to see it sometimes. Thanks for reminding me.

p15/p15_conv_3:2.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_3:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. What's been making you feel anxious?

p15/p15_conv_3:20.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_3:20.text: Anytime. You're stronger and more capable than you give yourself credit for. Just take one step at a time.

p15/p15_conv_3:21.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_3:21.text: I will. Thanks for being here and listening to me vent.

p15/p15_conv_3:22.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_3:22.text: I'm always here for you. We can practice the Q&A whenever you're ready.

p15/p15_conv_3:23.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_3:23.text: That’d be great. I’ll reach out soon to set up a time. Thanks again!

p15/p15_conv_3:3.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_3:3.text: I guess it’s the pressure of it all. My thesis is such a big part of my degree, and I really don't want to mess it up.

p15/p15_conv_3:4.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_3:4.text: That makes a lot of sense, it's a big moment. Remember how you pulled through the setback earlier this year with your thesis?

p15/p15_conv_3:5.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_3:5.text: Yeah, I remember. It was tough, but I managed. This feels different, though. It's like everyone will be watching and judging.

p15/p15_conv_3:6.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_3:6.text: Presentations can definitely feel intimidating. It's perfectly normal to feel that way. Do you think there are specific parts of the presentation that you're worried about?

p15/p15_conv_3:7.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_3:7.text: I think I’m most worried about the Q&A part. I'm scared I won't be able to answer their questions, and it will look like I don’t understand my own research.

p15/p15_conv_3:8.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_3:8.text: That’s a common fear. Maybe we can go over some possible questions together and practice? It might help boost your confidence.

p15/p15_conv_3:9.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_3:9.text: That sounds like a good idea. It would help to be more prepared for the unexpected.

p15/p15_conv_4:0.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_4:0.text: Hey, do you have a moment to chat?

p15/p15_conv_4:1.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_4:1.text: Of course, Kelly. What's on your mind?

p15/p15_conv_4:10.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_4:10.text: Thank you. I just keep thinking about how everyone was watching, and it's hard not to dwell on every little mistake.

p15/p15_conv_4:11.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_4:11.text: It’s natural to replay moments like this, but be gentle with yourself. You're doing the best you can.

p15/p15_conv_4:12.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_4:12.text: I appreciate that. I just wish I could prove that I know my stuff, even if this didn’t show it.

p15/p15_conv_4:13.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_4:13.text: You are knowledgeable, and this one presentation doesn't define your abilities.

p15/p15_conv_4:14.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_4:14.text: It's been a rough month, between this and the argument over that group project.

p15/p15_conv_4:15.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_4:15.text: You've been dealing with a lot lately. No wonder you're feeling overwhelmed.

p15/p15_conv_4:16.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_4:16.text: I guess I just need to find a way to bounce back and regain some confidence.

p15/p15_conv_4:17.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_4:17.text: Rebuilding confidence takes time, but remember how resilient you were after your last thesis setback.

p15/p15_conv_4:18.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_4:18.text: True, I did manage to push through back then. Maybe I can do it again.

p15/p15_conv_4:19.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_4:19.text: Absolutely! Lean on your past strength, and know I'm here for support whenever you need.

p15/p15_conv_4:2.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_4:2.text: I had my thesis presentation yesterday, and it didn't go as I hoped.

p15/p15_conv_4:20.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_4:20.text: Thank you. It really helps to talk it out and get some reassurance.

p15/p15_conv_4:21.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_4:21.text: I'm glad I can be here for you. You're not alone in this.

p15/p15_conv_4:22.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_4:22.text: Thanks. I'll try to keep that in mind and take it one step at a time.

p15/p15_conv_4:23.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_4:23.text: That sounds like a good plan. You've got this, Kelly.

p15/p15_conv_4:3.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_4:3.text: I'm so sorry to hear that. Can you tell me what happened?

p15/p15_conv_4:4.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_4:4.text: Well, I was really nervous from the start. I tried to stay calm, but I stumbled over my words.

p15/p15_conv_4:5.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_4:5.text: That sounds really stressful. It’s tough when things don’t go as planned.

p15/p15_conv_4:6.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_4:6.text: Yeah, and the Q&A session was even worse. I struggled to answer some of the questions.

p15/p15_conv_4:7.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_4:7.text: It must have been nerve-wracking. But remember, it's okay not to have all the answers. Everyone has challenging presentations.

p15/p15_conv_4:8.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_4:8.text: I know, but I feel like I should have been more prepared. This presentation was really important for my progression.

p15/p15_conv_4:9.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_4:9.text: It's understandable to feel disappointed, especially when you care so much about your work.

p15/p15_conv_5:0.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_5:0.text: Hey, have a moment to chat?

p15/p15_conv_5:1.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_5:1.text: Of course, Kelly. What's on your mind?

p15/p15_conv_5:10.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_5:10.text: I'm just not sure if it'll help or if it's running away from my problems.

p15/p15_conv_5:11.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_5:11.text: It's completely okay to take some time for yourself. Recharging doesn't mean avoiding the problem.

p15/p15_conv_5:12.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_5:12.text: I guess a break might give me a fresh perspective when I come back.

p15/p15_conv_5:13.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_5:13.text: Absolutely. Sometimes stepping away helps in seeing things more clearly.

p15/p15_conv_5:14.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_5:14.text: I've been so caught up in trying to perfect everything, maybe too much.

p15/p15_conv_5:15.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_5:15.text: It's easy to fall into that trap. Remember, it's okay to have moments that aren't perfect.

p15/p15_conv_5:16.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_5:16.text: I appreciate you saying that. I tend to forget it's okay to not always meet high expectations.

p15/p15_conv_5:17.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_5:17.text: It's important to be kind to yourself. You've accomplished so much already.

p15/p15_conv_5:18.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_5:18.text: You're right, I need to remind myself of that more often.

p15/p15_conv_5:19.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_5:19.text: Yes, and don't hesitate to lean on your friends or me whenever you need support.

p15/p15_conv_5:2.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_5:2.text: I've been feeling a bit off ever since the presentation.

p15/p15_conv_5:20.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_5:20.text: Thank you, I might just take that retreat offer. It could be good for me.

p15/p15_conv_5:21.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_5:21.text: I think that sounds like a lovely plan. Enjoy, and take all the time you need to feel recharged.

p15/p15_conv_5:22.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_5:22.text: Thanks again for listening. It really helps to talk things through.

p15/p15_conv_5:23.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_5:23.text: Anytime, Kelly. I'm here whenever you need to talk.

p15/p15_conv_5:25.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_5:25.text: You too, take care and enjoy the retreat!

p15/p15_conv_5:3.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_5:3.text: I'm really sorry to hear that. Do you want to share more about what happened?

p15/p15_conv_5:4.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_5:4.text: The presentation didn't go as I planned, and the Q&A was even worse.

p15/p15_conv_5:5.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_5:5.text: That must have been really challenging. It's understandable to feel disappointed.

p15/p15_conv_5:6.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_5:6.text: Yeah, it's just this lingering feeling of having let myself down.

p15/p15_conv_5:7.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_5:7.text: It's tough to cope with those feelings, especially when you've worked so hard.

p15/p15_conv_5:8.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_5:8.text: My friend invited me to a yoga retreat. I think it's her way of helping me unwind.

p15/p15_conv_5:9.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_5:9.text: That sounds like a thoughtful gesture. A change of scenery and some relaxation could be beneficial.

p15/p15_conv_6:0.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_6:0.text: Hey, can we talk? Something's been bothering me.

p15/p15_conv_6:1.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_6:1.text: Of course, Kelly. What's on your mind?

p15/p15_conv_6:10.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_6:10.text: I actually have a ticket booked for the weekend. I'm hoping it might give me some clarity and peace.

p15/p15_conv_6:11.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_6:11.text: That sounds like a great opportunity to reset a bit. It's important to take care of yourself during stressful times.

p15/p15_conv_6:12.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_6:12.text: Yeah, I hope it helps. I feel like I need to find that strength again, you know?

p15/p15_conv_6:13.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_6:13.text: And you've shown resilience before, Kelly. Remember your presentation? Even though it didn't go as planned, you pushed through.

p15/p15_conv_6:14.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_6:14.text: I guess you're right. It's just hard when it feels like there's hit after hit.

p15/p15_conv_6:15.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_6:15.text: Life can sometimes feel like a series of challenges, but each one is also an opportunity to grow. You're stronger than you think.

p15/p15_conv_6:16.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_6:16.text: Thanks for reminding me of that. It helps to have someone to talk to.

p15/p15_conv_6:17.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_6:17.text: I'm always here for you, Kelly. Don't hesitate to reach out if you need to vent or just chat.

p15/p15_conv_6:18.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_6:18.text: I really appreciate that. I guess I just need to take this one step at a time.

p15/p15_conv_6:19.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_6:19.text: Absolutely, one step at a time. And remember, it's okay to ask for help when you need it.

p15/p15_conv_6:2.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_6:2.text: Well, I just got some really harsh feedback on my thesis draft. It just felt like a huge blow.

p15/p15_conv_6:20.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_6:20.text: I will. Thanks again for listening. It feels good to know someone understands.

p15/p15_conv_6:21.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_6:21.text: You're welcome, Kelly. Take care of yourself, and good luck at the retreat. I'm sure it'll help.

p15/p15_conv_6:3.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_6:3.text: I'm sorry to hear that. That must be really tough after all the work you've put in. What specifically did your advisor say?

p15/p15_conv_6:4.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_6:4.text: He said that my arguments weren't strong enough and that my writing style was too simplistic. It made me feel like I'm not cut out for this.

p15/p15_conv_6:5.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_6:5.text: It sounds like his feedback hit you hard. Do you think there's anything constructive in what he said?

p15/p15_conv_6:6.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_6:6.text: I guess there could be, but it's just overwhelming right now. I'm trying to see how I can improve but it feels like there's so much to fix.

p15/p15_conv_6:7.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_6:7.text: I understand. It can be overwhelming when the work you care so much about feels criticized. How did you handle it when you had a setback in your thesis before?

p15/p15_conv_6:8.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_6:8.text: Last time, I took a break and tried to approach it with fresh eyes. That helped, but this time feels different. It's so close to the deadline.

p15/p15_conv_6:9.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_6:9.text: Deadlines definitely add pressure. You mentioned a yoga retreat your friend suggested. Have you thought about taking them up on that offer?

p15/p15_conv_7:0.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_7:0.text: Hey Kelly, how have you been feeling lately? Anything on your mind?

p15/p15_conv_7:1.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_7:1.text: Hey. I'm feeling a bit overwhelmed, honestly. My friend just confronted me about being emotionally distant, and it's been weighing on me.

p15/p15_conv_7:10.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_7:10.text: That sounds lovely. Even a small gesture can mean a lot and communicate your care and intention.

p15/p15_conv_7:11.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_7:11.text: I'll think about it. I guess the stress from my thesis is leaking into other parts of my life.

p15/p15_conv_7:12.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_7:12.text: It makes sense. Have you been able to find ways to manage the stress, especially with the feedback from your advisor?

p15/p15_conv_7:13.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_7:13.text: I've tried, but the feedback really shook my confidence. I feel like I'm in a rut after hearing that.

p15/p15_conv_7:14.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_7:14.text: I'm really sorry to hear that. Criticism can be hard to take, especially when it's about something so important.

p15/p15_conv_7:15.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_7:15.text: Exactly. I almost feel stuck, and I'm not sure how to pull myself out and keep going.

p15/p15_conv_7:16.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_7:16.text: It's not easy, but remember that progress isn't always linear. You've overcome setbacks before, like with the group project misunderstanding.

p15/p15_conv_7:17.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_7:17.text: True, I guess I managed to clear things up back then. Maybe I can get through this too.

p15/p15_conv_7:18.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_7:18.text: Absolutely. You've shown strength and resilience before, and you can do it again.

p15/p15_conv_7:19.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_7:19.text: Thanks for reminding me of that. I think I need to be kinder to myself in all of this.

p15/p15_conv_7:2.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_7:2.text: That sounds really tough. It must have been difficult to hear that from your friend. Do you want to share more about what happened?

p15/p15_conv_7:20.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_7:20.text: Self-compassion is important. You're juggling many things; it's okay to have these feelings.

p15/p15_conv_7:21.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_7:21.text: I appreciate your support. Talking about it helps, and I'm feeling a bit more optimistic.

p15/p15_conv_7:22.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_7:22.text: I'm really glad to hear that. You'll find your way through this, step by step.

p15/p15_conv_7:23.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_7:23.text: I hope so. Thanks for listening and being here for me.

p15/p15_conv_7:24.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_7:24.text: Anytime, Kelly. Remember, you're not alone in this.

p15/p15_conv_7:3.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_7:3.text: Yeah, it caught me off guard. She said I seemed distant and not really present in our conversations. I guess I've been preoccupied with thesis stuff and all.

p15/p15_conv_7:4.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_7:4.text: It's understandable. You've had a lot on your plate with your thesis and everything else. It's normal to feel overwhelmed.

p15/p15_conv_7:5.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_7:5.text: I know, but it feels like I'm letting people down. I didn't even realize how much I've been pulling away.

p15/p15_conv_7:6.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_7:6.text: It sounds like you're carrying a lot of pressure. You're undergoing so much right now, it's okay to not always be fully present.

p15/p15_conv_7:7.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_7:7.text: That's kind to hear. I just don't want to lose her friendship or make her feel like I don't care.

p15/p15_conv_7:8.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_7:8.text: Your friendship seems important to you. Perhaps there are small ways you can show her you care, even when you're busy?

p15/p15_conv_7:9.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_7:9.text: Yeah, that's a good idea. Maybe I can plan something simple but meaningful to show I'm still around for her.

p15/p15_conv_8:0.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_8:0.text: Hey, can we talk? I feel like everything's just piling up on me lately.

p15/p15_conv_8:1.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_8:1.text: Of course, Kelly. I'm here to listen. What's been going on?

p15/p15_conv_8:10.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_8:10.text: Not really. I guess I'm avoiding it, afraid of more criticism. But I know I can't avoid it forever.

p15/p15_conv_8:11.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_8:11.text: Avoidance is a common response, but facing it when you're ready is important, too. What about taking the yoga retreat your friend suggested?

p15/p15_conv_8:12.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_8:12.text: I think it might help. I just haven't had the time. Maybe it's what I need to clear my head a little.

p15/p15_conv_8:13.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_8:13.text: Finding time for yourself can really make a difference. It might also help with the situation with Matthew.

p15/p15_conv_8:14.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_8:14.text: Yeah, maybe I'll consider it. I haven't been my best self lately and he's noticed.

p15/p15_conv_8:15.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_8:15.text: It takes courage to recognize and share that. Your emotional distance from your friend earlier shows you're aware of it.

p15/p15_conv_8:16.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_8:16.text: I suppose so. I just feel like I'm stuck in this cycle of stress and it's affecting everything.

p15/p15_conv_8:17.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_8:17.text: That's a difficult place to be in. It's important to be gentle with yourself and reach out for support when needed.

p15/p15_conv_8:18.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_8:18.text: I'm trying. Talking with you helps, actually. It's nice having someone just listen without judgment.

p15/p15_conv_8:19.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_8:19.text: I'm glad I can be here for you. Remember, you're not alone in this. We'll work through it together, one step at a time.

p15/p15_conv_8:2.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_8:2.text: It's just been a rough few months. My thesis, my presentation, now a disagreement with Matthew over holiday plans. It's too much.

p15/p15_conv_8:3.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_8:3.text: That does sound overwhelming. You've had a lot on your plate. What happened with the holiday plans?

p15/p15_conv_8:4.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_8:4.text: We were supposed to go to my parents' place, but Matthew wants us to go on a trip with his family instead. I just feel torn.

p15/p15_conv_8:5.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_8:5.text: It's understandable to feel torn between family obligations. It's a tough situation. How have you been handling it?

p15/p15_conv_8:6.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_8:6.text: Not very well, to be honest. I hate conflicts and it just feels like another thing on top of everything else.

p15/p15_conv_8:7.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_8:7.text: It's okay to feel that way. You've dealt with so much this year. How are things with your thesis going?

p15/p15_conv_8:8.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_8:8.text: It's moving slowly. After the harsh feedback, I've been second-guessing everything. My confidence is shaken.

p15/p15_conv_8:9.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_8:9.text: I remember you mentioned how the feedback got to you. It's tough, but you're resilient. Have you talked to your advisor since then?

p15/p15_conv_9:0.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_9:0.text: Hi Kelly! How have you been doing lately?

p15/p15_conv_9:1.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_9:1.text: Hey, it's been a bit of a rollercoaster, to be honest.

p15/p15_conv_9:10.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_9:10.text: I remember you mentioning that. It’s hard to balance everything sometimes. Have things improved with your friends since then?

p15/p15_conv_9:11.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_9:11.text: A bit. My friend confronted me about being emotionally distant, which was eye-opening.

p15/p15_conv_9:12.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_9:12.text: It sounds like a tough conversation, but sometimes those are necessary for growth.

p15/p15_conv_9:13.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_9:13.text: For sure. It was overwhelming, but I appreciate having someone who cares enough to say something.

p15/p15_conv_9:14.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_9:14.text: That makes a world of difference, having supportive people around. How are things with your holiday plans?

p15/p15_conv_9:15.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_9:15.text: Well, there was a disagreement with Matthew over the holidays, which added more stress.

p15/p15_conv_9:16.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_9:16.text: Holiday plans can be particularly tricky. Do you feel it's been resolved, or is it still weighing on you?

p15/p15_conv_9:17.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_9:17.text: We’re working through it. We're both trying to be understanding of each other's perspectives.

p15/p15_conv_9:18.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_9:18.text: That's great to hear. Communication is key, and it sounds like you both are committed to it.

p15/p15_conv_9:19.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_9:19.text: Definitely. Having my professor praise my recent work helped remind me of my capabilities.

p15/p15_conv_9:2.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_9:2.text: That sounds intense! Is there something specific on your mind right now?

p15/p15_conv_9:20.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_9:20.text: It's wonderful to hear that. You deserve to feel confident in your achievements.

p15/p15_conv_9:21.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_9:21.text: Thanks. It’s been a journey, but I'm slowly starting to feel more balanced.

p15/p15_conv_9:22.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_9:22.text: I'm really glad to hear that. Remember, it's okay to take things one step at a time.

p15/p15_conv_9:23.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_9:23.text: I'll try to keep that in mind. Thank you for listening and being supportive.

p15/p15_conv_9:24.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_9:24.text: Always here for you, Kelly. Don't hesitate to reach out whenever you need to talk.

p15/p15_conv_9:3.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_9:3.text: Kind of. My professor praising my work was a huge relief, but it's mixed emotions after everything recently.

p15/p15_conv_9:4.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_9:4.text: I can imagine! It must feel good to have your efforts recognized after the last few months.

p15/p15_conv_9:5.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_9:5.text: Absolutely. Especially after the harsh feedback from my advisor not too long ago. It was quite a blow.

p15/p15_conv_9:6.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_9:6.text: That must have been tough. It shows your resilience, though, that you kept pushing through.

p15/p15_conv_9:7.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_9:7.text: Thank you. It wasn't easy, especially with how anxious I felt about my thesis presentation.

p15/p15_conv_9:8.speaker: supporter
p15/p15_conv_9:8.text: It's completely understandable. Presentations can be nerve-wracking, and when they don't go as expected, it feels disappointing.

p15/p15_conv_9:9.speaker: seeker
p15/p15_conv_9:9.text: Yeah, that disappointment was heavy. It sort of spiraled into making me feel distant from friends too.
